sources.title: schift-io · GitHub
sources.snippet: Every embedding model creates a different vector space. Switching providers means re-embedding your entire corpus — millions of vectors, days of compute, production downtime. Schift solves this. Our projection matrices transform existing vectors into any target model's space with 99.7% retrieval recovery, in minutes instead of days.
